Open Google Earth Pro right now.

This is where the fleet rises from.
Part 3 was the WHO. This is the WHERE.

video_overlay_text_observed: Mock Google Earth Pro interface with garbled labels ('Prienes Astrid Coast', 'Coudrelres', 'Coduirares', 'Guarch'), date slider, pixelated blur circle; side-by-side '2019 / 2021' heat map labeled 'European Sentinel-2 Thermal Anaqilign'; cutaway of an ice shaft labeled '22m' and '1,180'; red no-fly cylinder labeled 'PERMANT NO-FLY ZONE' with NOTAM tags; 'THE TREARCTIC TREATY ... 54 NATIONS'; flag line at a composite station; '2023 Magnetometer Data' chart captioned December 7, 2023 and 70.753 S, 11.685 E; 'Side-by-side UFO reports' map: 1997 Phoenix, 2004 Nimitz, 2023 Alaska; '2019 - CLEAR' and 'BLURRED BY GOOGLE'; 'Who Told Them To Blur and Why???'. Garbled text and impossible map geometry mark the visuals as generated, not screen recordings.
audio_content_summary: Unidentified narrator with no on-camera speaker, over generated Earth-view visuals. Names a coordinate at 70°45'12"S, 11°41'07"E, then stacks a Sentinel-2 thermal anomaly in 2019, a March 2021 Google and Bing blur, Norwegian Polar Institute radar of a 22-meter shaft through 1,180 meters of ice, a five-nautical-mile no-fly cylinder, and a 7 December 2023 pulse that cut telemetry at 68 stations. Concludes that UFO waves correlate with the site and that a fleet commutes through the shaft. Tells the viewer to verify in Google Earth Pro.
implied_frame: Frames a coordinate in the Schirmacher Oasis as the hidden entrance to a UFO base, shielded by treaty and map blurring, with the caption's '-18°C in -34°C ice' and 'first comment' before/after as the proof. Group A (verified, recorded): Schirmacher Oasis is an ice-free range near 70°45'S 11°40'E (2023-schirmacher-shaft-claim-001); Antarctic Treaty Article I bans military measures (2023-antarctic-pulse-claim-001). Group B (unresolved or contested): Bing's coarse tile as a March 2021 replacement (coarse today, date not established); the five-nautical-mile no-fly cylinder (absent from published Treaty plans, restricted flight manual unread); the environmental rationale for it; the UFO-wave correlation (no data offered); the fleet-elevator interpretation; '54-nation' (58 parties). Group C (searched, no primary trace or contradicted by instrument data): Sentinel-2 thermal anomaly (no thermal band; Landsat read +7°C); 'no station' (Maitri is 2.2 km away); '2.3 km northeast' of the oasis (the point is inside it); Google's March 2021 blur (no capture dated then); Norwegian Polar Institute radar shaft (nearest trace 62 km); the 22-meter circle (11 dated captures show rock); the 68-station telemetry loss; the triangulated pulse; ice more than 3 km thick. Cover and visuals are generated, so frames were not treated as evidence. A real nine-year gap in Google's high-resolution captures runs from December 2016 to November 2025 and is shared by Maitri.
